project.label: Playable worlds and pre-G0 game direction research
project.thesis: Keep registered product truth separate from Game Core research, and use cheap falsifiers plus playable proof before selecting the next game or deciding where Runtime Agents add value.
project.question: Which game forms are worth building next, and what role should Agents play only after simpler forms survive player-facing pressure?
owns: Registered Station Zero product and executable Game truth
Game Core research treatments and player-facing experiments
R1–R29 Game Foundations research corpus and reopen conditions
Pre-G0 direction search and playable-proof evidence
boundary: Station Zero v2 is the only registered current product
Station Zero v3, Casefile, Last Light, and Echo Hunt are research/reference treatments rather than selected product stages
No next Ordivon Game product has been selected from the recent direction experiments
Foundation expansion is provisionally frozen after R29 and reopens only on a concrete counterexample
No generic Host, Runtime, or universal Game-engine authority
project.problem: A technically impressive Agent mechanic can still fail to create a game worth playing. Game now separates product registration, foundation research, game-form search, Agent participation, and player-facing proof so architecture does not substitute for Player Value.
project.capability: Runs registered Station Zero v2 while retaining Station Zero v3, Casefile, Concept Lab, and other treatments as executable research pressure. The R1–R29 corpus provides a compact Game Foundations map, and the current Pre-G0 programme uses cheap falsifiers plus bounded playable proofs to search game form before any G0 product admission.
project.maturity: Registered playable v2 product plus active Pre-G0 direction research; no next product selected
project.audience: Players, game designers, and Agent researchers examining how game form, delegation, partial knowledge, persistent subjects, and Agent participation become—or fail to become—player value.
project.latestProof: R29 froze further foundation expansion after synthesizing R1–R28. The next Pre-G0 search then separated GameForm from Agent role, ran cheap falsifiers, and materialized a bounded A/D/I playable-proof wave with mechanical browser evidence while keeping C0/C1 human Player Value explicitly unobserved.
project.summary: Ordivon Game separates one registered playable product from executable research treatments, frozen foundation knowledge, and the current Pre-G0 search for what game should be built next. Recent playable proofs are evidence for direction search, not a product-selection event.
project.state: Station Zero v2 remains the only registered current product. Station Zero v3 and the newer treatments remain executable reference/research surfaces. The R1–R29 foundation-expansion programme is provisionally frozen; current work is Pre-G0 direction search and bounded playable proof, with no next product selected and no human Player Value claim from the current mechanical evidence.
